registration.title: Voter Registration Guide
steps: Check your eligibility (Age 18+, Citizenship).
Visit the official Voter Portal (NVSP) or use the Voter Helpline App.
Fill out Form 6 for new registration.
Upload required documents (ID proof, Address proof, Photo).
Submit and track your reference ID.
registration.tip: Register early! Most states close registration 2-4 weeks before election day.

voting.title: How to Cast Your Vote
steps: Find your assigned polling booth using your Epic ID.
Bring a valid Photo ID (Voter ID, Aadhaar, etc.).
Get your finger inked and sign the register.
Pressed the button for your candidate on the EVM.
Wait for the BEEP sound and verify the VVPAT slip.
voting.tip: If you are in line when the polls close, you are legally entitled to vote. Don't leave!

documents.title: Required Identification
steps: Voter ID Card (EPIC Card).
Aadhaar Card.
PAN Card.
Passport.
Driving License.
documents.tip: Even without a physical Voter ID card, you can vote if your name is in the electoral roll and you have another valid photo ID.

timeline.title: Election Timeline Phase
steps: Notification & Nomination Period.
Scrutiny of Proposals.
Campaigning Period (Ends 48hrs before poll).
Polling Day.
Counting of Votes & Declaration.
timeline.tip: Check the official ECI website for state-specific dates.

results.title: Election Results Process
steps: Sealing of EVMs at the polling station.
Secure storage in Strong Rooms.
Counting day process under observer supervision.
Real-time update on the ECI app/website.
results.tip: Only trust results declared by the Election Commission of India officials.
